summary: Eight compute-bound experiments completed in 42.9 wall-time minutes (averaging 5 minutes per experiment) based on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction. The longest executions were 'Qualify normalized training under a frozen affected scope' at 20.0 minutes and 'Qualify sentence custody and complete evidence views together' at 14.41 minutes, which combined accounted for 34.41 minutes (80.2% of the total milestone wall time). The monitor report captured an end-state snapshot showing both RTX 3090 GPUs idle at 0% utilization with 5MB and 4MB allocated upon milestone completion, while active-window compute efficiency across the 42.9 minutes was unmeasured and no multi-model workload requiring DualGPURunner was present.
bottlenecks_identified: The top two compute-bound tasks ('Qualify normalized training under a frozen affected scope' at 20.0 minutes and 'Qualify sentence custody and complete evidence views together' at 14.41 minutes) consumed 34.41 of the 42.9 total wall-time minutes (80.2%), but the records lack intra-task stage timing to identify specific phase overheads.
Total milestone wall time was derived via disk-mtime fallback reconstruction because the live git-log path found 0 commits, leaving explicit task boundaries and startup/teardown durations unrecorded.

The GPU monitor report provides an isolated post-execution snapshot (both GPUs idle at 0% utilization with 5MB and 4MB allocated at 2026-09-27T18:21:50Z), preventing evaluation of continuous active-window accelerator utilization patterns across the full 42.9 minutes.
improvements_suggested: Persist structured task execution receipts containing monotonic start, finish, and intra-task phase timers to eliminate fallback timing reconstruction.
Implement continuous background GPU metric sampling (utilization, VRAM allocation, and temperature) throughout task lifecycles linked to task identifiers.
Profile intra-task stages (data preparation, model forward passes, validation checks, and artifact serialization) for training qualification and sentence custody workflows to isolate internal delays.
Record explicit concurrent model load declarations in task definitions to enable verifiable DualGPURunner eligibility assessment.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add monotonic sub-phase timers to experiment receipts for long-running training and sentence custody qualification routines to isolate intra-task overheads.
Implement continuous task-correlated GPU telemetry recording to evaluate active-window compute efficiency across the entire run.
Persist structured milestone execution receipts at conductor boundaries to eliminate disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
meta_reflection: The monitor snapshot demonstrates quiescent GPUs (both RTX 3090 GPUs at 0% utilization, 5MB and 4MB allocated) at the milestone completion timestamp 2026-09-27T18:21:50Z, reflecting finished tasks rather than an active-task compute stall. Because accelerator metrics were not captured continuously across the 42.9 minutes and tasks omitted sub-phase timings, internal execution bottlenecks cannot be confirmed from available records. Estimated time savings remain 0% until proposed telemetry and profiling tooling are empirically measured against established baselines.
